`v0.12.1` fixes setup and updates failing on some home networks.

# Fixes

* Fix setup and update downloads failing with "winapi error #12167" on networks where Windows finds a proxy setup server that serves no proxy script, such as Fritz!Box routers and SK Broadband (#356)
* Finish the Korean translation for Links from Windows and installing updates from downloaded files (#357)

## Thanks 🙏

* @AI-Dico for tracking down the proxy failure and fixing it, and for the Korean translation (#356, #357)
* @Mexican-Judo for confirming it also blocked first setup on a Fritz!Box network (#356)
